text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Days were spent training intensely in 
preparation for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —...Phew! I'm going for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We're almost at the summit... aren't 
we...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Phew—!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: 1000! *pant*, *pant*! One more set...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through days of grueling training that 
pushed beyond her limits, Victoire Pisa's 
true strength steadily took shape.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, bringing some snacks for Pisa-chan 
while she works hard? Of course, go right 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for today... let's see. I should 
be able to prepare our special 
high-protein meat buns, or the currently 
super popular special chocolate carrots."

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text: Coming right up, just give me a sec!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A special meat bun? Oh my...! Thank you so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"May I dig in right away? To be honest, 
I'm quite hungry."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...*munch*. ...Heheh, yeah. It's super 
delicious♪"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Besides... meat buns really are such a 
wonderful food, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Meat and skin— it is only when the two 
become one that this special deliciousness 
is born, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A happiness born purely because both exist 
together... Truly a harmonious circle of 
ingredients, isn't it? Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, after ceaseless training, one day 
near the end of the summer training camp 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text: Coming right up, just give me a sec!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Special chocolate carrots, you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, everyone at the training camp 
was talking about it yesterday. They said 
it's so much richer and more delicious 
than regular chocolate carrots...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I wanted to try it. Fufu, 
thank you so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...*munch*. *chew*... *chew*...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Mm!? D-Delicious! Well, it's quite modern, 
but it also has depth—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The taste was great, of course, 
but... I was just happy to be included in 
everyone's circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Tonight in our room, I simply must tell 
you my thoughts on how it tastes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, after ceaseless training, one day 
near the end of the summer training camp 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A beach flags tournament, you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's scheduled to be held as a 
recreational activity during this year's 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who brought that news was Air 
Groove, the student council vice president 
and Rulership's senior apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"While its primary purpose is a change of 
pace for the students, it also serves to 
drum up excitement for racing culture. We 
are planning to have a live audience."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you're reaching out to 
Umamusume active in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I see. Thank you for reaching out to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your exceptional ability and immense 
popularity have come through loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know you're busy with training right 
now, but I'd like you to consider 
participating, if only to take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"My, what a massive crowd! To think so 
many people came out to see us."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To weave a grand circle at the Arima 
Kinen, name recognition is essential.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This might be a fine opportunity to make 
myself more known to everyone.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best and aim for victory!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A crushing victory for Victoire Pisa! With 
skillful maneuvers, she captures the flag 
in brilliant fashion!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe falls just short! —The victor 
is Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She dodges Rose Kingdom's fierce assault! 
—Victoire Pisa advances to the finals!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What a relief. I managed to make it to the 
finals safely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If I recall, the opponent was—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista advances to the finals---!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to everyone's support. 
I'll do my very best in the finals, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista. Having walked the Tiara 
route, she is currently active in the 
Senior Class, an Umamusume with a bright 
and pure aura.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Currently boasting 4 GⅠ victories and 
having never missed the board, her 
strength is beyond doubt. On top of that, 
what deserves special mention is—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"UOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!" "Buena Vista, do 
your beeeeeeest!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an overwhelming level of 
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A runner who unleashes her late surge from 
any position, giving her all in the 
pursuit of victory.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It is that very presence that captures and 
moves people's hearts... making you the 
most watched Umamusume in every single 
race so far.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...She is a formidable opponent. We must 
stay sharp."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually—the time for the decisive 
battle arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, both are neck and neck! Neither 
is giving an inch!! Is it Buena?! Is it 
Pisa?! Buena, or Pisa?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Just a little more, just a little 
more...! We're so close—and yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (...Too... far away...!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And the winnerrr goes to...!!! BUENA 
VISTAAAAAAA!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—...gh, thank you so much! I could hear 
everyone's cheers so clearly...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I plan to enter many races this autumn as 
well. I am sure I will cross paths with 
those in the Classic class as well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"They are truly formidable. However— no 
matter who the opponent is, I will not 
lose! Because there is only one view I 
wish to show everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Pisa-san...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I felt your strength firsthand. That is 
precisely why I look forward to the day we 
race on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because competing fiercely with you is 
bound to be intense...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaaa!" "That was amazing!" 
"Can't wait for what's next!" "Keep it up, 
let's go!" "We'll always, always keep 
cheering for you!!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: She is truly an incredible person.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The charisma that earns the love of so 
many people, backed by undeniable 
skill...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I was aware of it beforehand, but 
facing it directly... the sheer presence 
was overwhelming."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a race, but beach flags. Still, 
it was more than enough to witness Buena 
Vista's strength and immense popularity 
firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...You'll likely be running in the Arima 
Kinen, right? And perhaps you might even 
enter the Japan Cup as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This race will surely draw even more 
attention than in typical years.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If only I could run well enough to rival 
someone like her...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, we might be able to 
expand a huge circle beyond the racetrack 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However... at this rate, my skills still 
won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If I don't undergo further training, I 
won't make it in time. I must brace 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps struck by the tremendous display 
she had just witnessed, Victoire Pisa's 
expression clouds over—
choice_data_list: It's okay, let's do our best together!

Don't worry, let's give it our all 
together!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To gain strength on par with Buena Vista, 
and create a circle of connection that 
reaches beyond the race—
choice_data_list:
I'll do everything in my power to help you 
achieve that!

I'll do everything in my power to help you 
achieve that!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... you are right. After all, I am 
not alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of "an even greater circle"— 
let us sprint through together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To connect the circle at the Arima 
Kinen—an even more passionate summer was 
about to begin!
